import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class RainboyVariant extends PrintWriter {
    Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        RainboyVariant program = new RainboyVariant();
        program.run();
        program.flush();
    }

    void run() {
        int n = scanner.nextInt() / 2;
        int totalNodes = n + 26 + 2;
        int[][] edges = new int[totalNodes][totalNodes];
        int[] capacity = new int[totalNodes];
        int[] flow = new int[totalNodes];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int idx1 = scanner.nextInt();
            int idx2 = scanner.nextInt();
            edges[idx1][idx2]++;
            edges[idx2][idx1]++;
        }

        String s = scanner.next();
        int[] counts = new int[26];
        for (char c : s.toCharArray()) {
            counts[c - 'a']++;
        }

        int source = 0;
        int sink = totalNodes - 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
            int charNode = n + i + 1;
            edges[source][charNode] = counts[i];
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            edges[i][sink] = 1; 
        }

        int maxFlow = 0;
        while (true) {
            int[] parent = new int[totalNodes];
            Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(source);
            parent[source] = source;
            while (!q.isEmpty() && parent[sink] == -1) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int v = 0; v < totalNodes; v++) {
                    if (edges[u][v] - flow[u] < capacity[v] && parent[v] == -1 && edges[u][v] > 0) {
                        parent[v] = u;
                        q.add(v);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (parent[sink] == -1) break;
            int delta = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            for (int v = sink; v != source; v = parent[v]) {
                int u = parent[v];
                delta = Math.min(delta, edges[u][v] - flow[u]);
            }
            for (int v = sink; v != source; v = parent[v]) {
                int u = parent[v];
                flow[u] += delta;
                flow[v] -= delta;
            }
            maxFlow += delta;
        }

        println(maxFlow >= n ? "YES" : "NO");
    }
}
